title: Euro Finance Week: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland holds roundtable with financial sector leaders

paras.text: In her opening remarks, Rowland set out how AMLA is working towards a more integrated, risk-based AML/CFT framework in the EU. She covered three topics: the regulatory priorities most relevant to industry, simplification and proportionality, and AMLA’s approach to supervision. She encouraged institutions to engage early and prepare for the new framework.
The discussion was held under the Chatham House Rule. Participants shared their perspectives and raised questions on how the new framework will be implemented.
